Yes, that's the right boundary. The important thing for me is that my saved bookmarks and named collections are still there when I come back to the app later on the same computer — that's what makes it worth saving them at all. Temporary things like a search I typed, ticked checkboxes, or a half-open form resetting is completely fine.

And you're right that I haven't asked for my collection to follow me across different computers — for now, just having it stick around on my own computer is enough.
